module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading
framing_rule: No word in this block is described as pure, impure, correct, corrupted, better or worse than its partner. Both members of every pair are current Hindi, chosen by situation. Module 15 states this explicitly; this block must not contradict it in advance. Note also that levels 25 to 27 take the Sanskrit-side word as the item and levels 28 to 29 take the Urdu-side word, so that neither side is presented as the real word and the other as a variant.

learn.title_en: A pair is rarely a straight swap
learn.explanation_en: प्रारंभ is the formal word for a beginning, and शुरू is what people say — but the two do not line up neatly. शुरू is an invariable word that behaves like an adjective, so you say काम शुरू हुआ; प्रारंभ is a masculine noun, so you say कार्यक्रम का प्रारंभ. And the noun built from शुरू is शुरुआत, which is feminine. One idea, three words, two genders and two parts of speech. Flag प्रारंभ: masculine, consonant-final, nothing in the shape to tell you.

examples.hindi: कार्यक्रम का प्रारंभ छह बजे होगा।
examples.read_as: kaaryakram kaa praaraṁbh chhah baje hogaa.
examples.english: The programme will begin at six.
examples.note: का because प्रारंभ is masculine.
शुरू does not inflect and is not a noun here.

examples.english: It got off to a good start.
examples.note: शुरुआत is feminine, so अच्छी and रही.

common_error.why_en: प्रारंभ is masculine, while शुरुआत, which means much the same, is feminine.

practice.prompt_en: Which of these is a feminine noun?
practice.explanation_en: शुरुआत is feminine. प्रारंभ is masculine and शुरू is not a noun at all.

game.question_en: Which word means an inauguration or formal opening ceremony?
game.explanation_en: उद्घाटन is the ceremony itself. आरंभ is another word for a beginning and is close to प्रारंभ in every way.

tts_strings: कार्यक्रम का प्रारंभ छह बजे होगा।

learn.title_en: समाप्त and ख़त्म — a pair that really is a straight swap
learn.explanation_en: After प्रारंभ, this is the easy case. समाप्त and ख़त्म are both invariable, both go with होना and करना, and both mean finished. You can replace either with the other and change nothing but the setting: बैठक समाप्त हुई in a report, बैठक ख़त्म हुई in conversation. Some pairs really are that clean. The noun from समाप्त is समापन, masculine, and there is no everyday equivalent for it — you would say ख़त्म होना instead.

examples.note: बैठक is feminine, so हुई. समाप्त itself never changes.
The everyday partner, in the sentence you already heard from a shopkeeper in level 3.
समापन, the noun, masculine — and formal-only.

common_error.why_en: समाप्त is invariable. There is no feminine form.

practice.prompt_en: How do समाप्त and ख़त्म differ?
options: Only in the setting they belong to
practice.explanation_en: They behave identically. A report uses one and a conversation the other.

game.question_en: Which word means the conclusion of an event, as a noun?
game.explanation_en: समापन is the noun. अंतिम means final or last, which is an adjective.

learn.title_en: कठिन is only an adjective, where मुश्किल is both
learn.explanation_en: You met कठिन in passing back in level 2, as the formal partner of मुश्किल. Here is the asymmetry: मुश्किल is a noun as well as an adjective — एक मुश्किल आ गई, a difficulty has come up — while कठिन is an adjective only. The noun on the Sanskrit side is कठिनाई, feminine, built with the -आई suffix from level 2. So the two sides cover the same ground with a different number of words, which is the normal state of affairs for these pairs.

examples.note: Invariable, and the noun it describes makes no difference.

examples.english: He had a great deal of difficulty.
examples.note: कठिनाई, feminine because of the -आई suffix, so हुई.
The everyday partner. Both sentences are equally correct.

common_error.why_en: कठिन cannot be a noun. For a difficulty as a thing, use मुश्किल or कठिनाई.

practice.prompt_en: Which of these can be used as a noun?
practice.explanation_en: मुश्किल is both a noun and an adjective. कठिन is only an adjective.

game.question_en: Which word means strict or severe rather than difficult?
game.explanation_en: सख़्त is strict, or hard to the touch. भारी is heavy and गहरा is deep.

summary.recap_en: A register pair is rarely a straight swap. प्रारंभ is a noun while शुरू is not, and the noun on the other side is शुरुआत, feminine. समाप्त and ख़त्म genuinely are interchangeable. And कठिन is an adjective only, where मुश्किल is both adjective and noun.
summary.next_up_en: Next: three pairs where both words are in daily use, and one of them also means north.

learn.title_en: प्रश्न and सवाल — both alive, in different rooms
learn.explanation_en: प्रश्न and सवाल both mean a question and both are masculine, so there is no gender trap here. What separates them is where they live: an exam paper is a प्रश्न पत्र, a grammar book talks about प्रश्नवाचक शब्द, and a person asking you something asks a सवाल. Neither is more correct. Flag प्रश्न anyway: masculine and consonant-final, with nothing in the shape to tell you.

examples.note: A compound where सवाल would not be used.
The everyday partner, and सवाल पूछना is what people say.
ही narrowing it to the question rather than the answer.

common_error.why_en: The compound is fixed. सवाल is free as a word but does not go into this one.

practice.prompt_en: Which would appear on a school exam?
practice.explanation_en: The compound is fixed even though the free words are interchangeable.

game.question_en: Which word means a problem to be solved, as in mathematics?
game.explanation_en: समस्या is a problem. सवाल can mean a sum in school arithmetic, but a problem in the general sense is समस्या.

learn.explanation_en: उत्तर is an answer, and it is also the compass direction north — उत्तर प्रदेश is the northern state, not the answering one. The two senses are unrelated in use and only context separates them, which makes this one worth flagging twice over. The everyday partner for the answer sense is जवाब, also masculine, and both go with देना. Note जवाब नहीं, which literally says there is no answer and idiomatically means something is beyond compare — a compliment, not a complaint.

examples.note: देना for both उत्तर and जवाब.

examples.hindi: दिल्ली भारत के उत्तर में है।
examples.read_as: dillii bhaarat ke uttar meṁ hai.
examples.english: Delhi is in the north of India.
examples.note: The other sense entirely, and nothing but context tells you.
A compliment, despite what the words literally say.

common_error.why_en: An answer is given, not done — with either उत्तर or जवाब.

practice.explanation_en: उत्तर is north here. Context is the only guide.

game.question_en: Which word means a reply to a letter, in formal writing?
game.explanation_en: प्रत्युत्तर is a formal reply, with प्रति- meaning back or in return. उत्तर and जवाब are both ordinary answers.

tts_strings: दिल्ली भारत के उत्तर में है।

learn.title_en: समय, वक़्त, टाइम — three words, all in daily use
learn.explanation_en: समय is time, and it is the neutral, slightly formal word. वक़्त is the Urdu-side partner and is warmer — it is what songs and poetry use, and what people say when time is doing something to them: वक़्त बदल गया. And टाइम, the English word, is entirely ordinary in speech: टाइम क्या हुआ? All three are masculine, so the grammar does not change. Flag समय: masculine, consonant-final, unguessable.

examples.note: समय पर, which you saw on the ticket window sign in level 16.
वक़्त is what this sentence wants. समय would sound like a report.
The commonest way to ask, by a wide margin.

common_error.right: टाइम क्या हुआ? / क्या समय हुआ है?
common_error.why_en: Grammatically fine, but nobody asks the time that way. The word and the sentence shape have to match.

practice.prompt_en: Which word would a song most likely use?
practice.explanation_en: वक़्त carries more feeling. अवधि, from level 16, is a measured period and would be absurd in a song.

game.question_en: Which word means an era or age?
game.explanation_en: युग is an era. घड़ी is a clock or watch, and also a moment.

summary.recap_en: प्रश्न and सवाल, उत्तर and जवाब, समय and वक़्त — three pairs where both members are in daily use and neither is going anywhere. उत्तर also means north, which nothing but context will tell you. And time has a third word as well: टाइम.
summary.next_up_en: Next: three more pairs, and the question of whether the gender changes with the register.

learn.title_en: कार्य builds compounds that काम cannot
learn.explanation_en: कार्य and काम both mean work and both are masculine, so nothing changes grammatically. What changes is what they can build. कार्यक्रम is a programme, कार्यालय is an office — with the -आलय suffix from level 8 — कार्यकर्ता is a worker or activist, and कार्यवाही is proceedings. काम builds almost nothing: कामकाज is about the only one. Flag कार्य: masculine and consonant-final. You saw कार्य अवधि on the opening-hours board in level 16, which is exactly the kind of place it belongs.

examples.note: Formal. In speech this would be ये काम मुश्किल है.

examples.hindi: कार्यालय सुबह नौ बजे खुलता है।
examples.read_as: kaaryaalay subah nau baje khultaa hai.
examples.note: कार्य plus आलय. Speech would say ऑफ़िस.

examples.english: I have a lot of work.
examples.note: The everyday partner, with the dative from Module 10.

common_error.why_en: The compound takes कार्य. Free words swap; compounds do not.

practice.explanation_en: कार्य plus आलय, place — the same suffix as शौचालय and पुस्तकालय.

game.question_en: Which word means a worker or an activist?
game.explanation_en: कार्यकर्ता, one who does the work. कार्यक्रम is a programme and कार्यवाही is proceedings.

tts_strings: कार्यालय सुबह नौ बजे खुलता है।

learn.title_en: स्थान is masculine and जगह is feminine
learn.explanation_en: Here is the third gender mismatch in this module. स्थान and जगह both mean a place, and they have opposite genders — इस स्थान पर but इस जगह पर, यह स्थान अच्छा है but यह जगह अच्छी है. You have already met दिनांक against तारीख़ in level 20 and प्रयास against कोशिश in level 21, both mismatched. Flag स्थान. But do not conclude that the mismatch is a rule, because the next item is a pair that matches perfectly.

examples.note: Masculine, so सुरक्षित needs no change — but a masculine adjective would show it.
Feminine, so अच्छी. The same sentence with स्थान would be अच्छा.
स्थानीय, local — the -ईय suffix building an adjective.

common_error.why_en: जगह is feminine, even though स्थान, which means the same, is masculine.

practice.explanation_en: Same meaning, opposite genders — the third such pair in this module.

game.explanation_en: स्थानीय is local. स्थापित is established and स्थिर is stable or still.

learn.explanation_en: आवश्यकता and ज़रूरत both mean a need and both are feminine, so this pair changes nothing at all. That matters: after three mismatched pairs in a row it would be easy to assume the mismatch is systematic, and it is not. There is no rule — you have to know each pair. आवश्यकता is built with -ता, a suffix that makes feminine abstract nouns from adjectives, exactly as -आई and -ई do: सुंदरता beauty, स्वतंत्रता freedom, क्षमता capacity.

examples.english: There is no need for this.
examples.note: इसकी, feminine, agreeing with आवश्यकता.
The everyday partner, from level 1, and also feminine.

examples.hindi: आवश्यकतानुसार बदलाव किया जा सकता है।
examples.read_as: aavashyaktaanusaar badlaav kiyaa jaa saktaa hai.
examples.english: Changes may be made as required.
examples.note: आवश्यकतानुसार, as per requirement — the kind of compound only this side of the pair produces.

practice.explanation_en: सुंदरता, स्वतंत्रता, क्षमता, आवश्यकता — all feminine, all from adjectives.

game.question_en: Which word means capacity or ability?
game.explanation_en: क्षमता, from सक्षम, capable. All four are -ता nouns and all four are feminine.

summary.recap_en: Free words swap between registers; compounds do not — कार्यक्रम has no कामक्रम. स्थान and जगह are the third gender-mismatched pair in the module, after दिनांक/तारीख़ and प्रयास/कोशिश. And आवश्यकता and ज़रूरत match perfectly, which shows the mismatch is not a rule.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the direction reverses — the Urdu-side word becomes the item, starting with two prefixes for one meaning.

learn.title_en: नामुमकिन and असंभव — two prefixes, one meaning
learn.explanation_en: मुमकिन is possible, and संभव is its Sanskrit-side partner. Both are invariable. The interesting part is the negatives: मुमकिन takes ना- to give नामुमकिन, and संभव takes अ- to give असंभव. Both mean impossible, both are in daily use, and each keeps the prefix that belongs to its own side. That gives you a fifth way of negating in this module, after निः-, ला-, अ- and बिना — and ना-, like ला-, came in through Persian.

examples.note: Negating with नहीं rather than with a prefix.
The prefix version is stronger — flatly impossible rather than merely not possible.

examples.english: It is impossible for that to happen.
examples.note: The Sanskrit-side negative, with अ-.

common_error.why_en: Each word keeps the prefix from its own side. अ- does not attach to मुमकिन, and ना- does not attach to संभव.

practice.explanation_en: नामुमकिन. संभव takes अ- instead, giving असंभव.

game.question_en: Which word means likely rather than merely possible?
game.explanation_en: संभावित is probable or expected. मुमकिन and संभव only say a thing can happen.

learn.title_en: इंतज़ार is masculine and प्रतीक्षा is feminine
learn.explanation_en: The fourth mismatched pair. इंतज़ार is masculine, प्रतीक्षा is feminine, and they mean the same thing. You met प्रतीक्षा on the waiting-room sign in level 15, which is exactly where it belongs; इंतज़ार is what you say and what you write in a message — आपका इंतज़ार रहेगा, from the hotel confirmation in level 23. Flag इंतज़ार. Both go with करना, and the thing waited for takes का: तुम्हारा इंतज़ार.

examples.hindi: मैं तुम्हारा इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ।
examples.read_as: maiṁ tumhaaraa iṁtazaar kar rahaa huuṁ.
examples.note: तुम्हारा, masculine, agreeing with इंतज़ार.

examples.english: The waiting room is on the right.
examples.note: The sign register, from level 15.
लंबा masculine. With प्रतीक्षा it would be लंबी.

common_error.why_en: इंतज़ार is masculine, even though प्रतीक्षा, its partner, is feminine.

practice.explanation_en: इंतज़ार is masculine; प्रतीक्षा is feminine. The fourth such pair in the module.

game.question_en: Which word means a delay rather than the act of waiting?
game.explanation_en: देरी is lateness or delay. ठहराव is a pause or stillness, and you meet it in the final reading of the module.

tts_strings: मैं तुम्हारा इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ।

learn.title_en: ज़िंदगी and जीवन are not always swappable
learn.explanation_en: The fifth mismatched pair: ज़िंदगी is feminine and जीवन is masculine. But this one goes further than gender, because the two are not freely interchangeable. जीवन owns the compounds — जीवन बीमा is life insurance and जीवनसाथी is a life partner, and there is no ज़िंदगी बीमा. ज़िंदगी owns the feeling: songs, poetry and anything said with any warmth at all will use ज़िंदगी. Both are everyday words; they simply do different jobs.

examples.note: छोटी, feminine. With जीवन it would be छोटा — and it would sound like a textbook.
The compound takes जीवन and nothing else.

examples.english: He spent his whole life right here.
examples.note: गुज़ारना, to spend time — a verb you meet properly in level 50.

common_error.why_en: Free words swap; compounds do not. This is the same rule as कार्यक्रम in level 27.

practice.prompt_en: Which word appears in the compound for life insurance?
practice.explanation_en: जीवन बीमा. The compound is fixed.

game.question_en: Which word means a lifetime or an age?
game.explanation_en: उम्र is age or lifespan, and it is feminine. साँस is breath.

summary.recap_en: नामुमकिन and असंभव each keep the negative prefix from their own side — ना- from Persian, अ- from Sanskrit. इंतज़ार and ज़िंदगी are the fourth and fifth gender-mismatched pairs. And ज़िंदगी shows that a pair can differ in distribution as well as register: जीवन owns the compounds and ज़िंदगी owns the feeling.
summary.next_up_en: Next: news, country and education — and what happens to a pair inside a compound.

learn.title_en: ख़बर is a single item; समाचार is the broadcast
learn.explanation_en: The sixth mismatched pair: ख़बर is feminine and समाचार is masculine. But there is also a difference of grain. ख़बर is one piece of news — एक अच्छी ख़बर, a bit of good news — while समाचार is news as a body of it, which is why a bulletin is समाचार and a newspaper is समाचार पत्र. The Urdu-side word for a newspaper is अख़बार, masculine, and both are in daily use. Flag ख़बर. Note the idiom ख़बर रखना, to keep track of something.

examples.note: अच्छी, feminine, agreeing with ख़बर.

examples.english: Listen to the nine o'clock news.
examples.note: Masculine plural — a bulletin is समाचार, not ख़बर.
ख़बर रखना — one more रखना idiom, after the four on the waiting-room sign.

common_error.why_en: ख़बर is feminine, even though समाचार is masculine.

practice.prompt_en: A television news bulletin is called what?
practice.explanation_en: समाचार, because it is news as a body rather than one item.

game.explanation_en: अख़बार is a newspaper. ख़बरनवीस is a reporter, built with the Persian -नवीस, one who writes.

learn.title_en: Both masculine — and only one of them makes compounds
learn.explanation_en: मुल्क and देश both mean a country and both are masculine, so this pair matches. What it does not do is share the compounds. देशभक्ति is patriotism, विदेश is abroad, स्वदेशी means home-produced, and there is no मुल्कभक्ति or विमुल्क. Flag मुल्क: masculine and consonant-final, with nothing in the shape to say so. मुल्क is free as a word, warm in tone, and common in speech and song — अपना मुल्क, हमारा मुल्क — but it does not build. That is the same asymmetry you saw with कार्य and जीवन, and it is the most reliable difference between the two sides of any pair.

examples.note: Warm. देश here would sound like a civics lesson.
The compound takes देश. There is no विमुल्क.

examples.hindi: पूरे देश में यही हाल है।
examples.read_as: puure desh meṁ yahii haal hai.
examples.english: It's the same all over the country.
examples.note: हाल, the singular of हालात from level 4.

common_error.why_en: Compounds pick a side and stay there, whatever the free words do.

practice.prompt_en: Which of these is a real word?
practice.explanation_en: विदेश, abroad. The compounds are all built on देश.

game.question_en: Which word means a nation in the sense of a people?
game.explanation_en: राष्ट्र is a nation, and it is the word in राष्ट्रपति, president. इलाक़ा is an area or district.

learn.title_en: तालीम and शिक्षा — matched genders, unmatched institutions
learn.explanation_en: Both are feminine, so this pair matches grammatically. But every institution in India uses शिक्षा: शिक्षा मंत्रालय is the Ministry of Education, शिक्षक is a teacher, शिक्षित means educated. Flag तालीम: feminine and consonant-final. तालीम is what a person says — बच्चों की तालीम, the children's education — and it is especially at home in Urdu-influenced speech. The pattern from the last three levels holds one more time: the Sanskrit side takes the offices and the compounds, and the Urdu side keeps the conversation.

examples.hindi: बच्चों की तालीम पर ख़र्च करना चाहिए।
examples.read_as: bacchoṁ kii taaliim par ḳharch karnaa chaahie.
examples.english: One should spend on children's education.
examples.note: की, feminine, and बच्चों oblique before it.

examples.english: The Ministry of Education made an announcement.
examples.note: मंत्रालय — another -आलय word. And तालीम मंत्रालय does not exist.
The everyday way to say it — a paired participle, avoiding both words entirely.

common_error.why_en: Institutions take शिक्षा. The free words are interchangeable; the names are not.

practice.prompt_en: Which word would a government department use in its name?
practice.explanation_en: शिक्षा मंत्रालय. तालीम belongs to conversation.

game.question_en: Which word means training, in the practical sense?
game.explanation_en: प्रशिक्षण is training, with the प्र- prefix. पढ़ाई is studying, and is built with the -आई suffix from level 2.

tts_strings: बच्चों की तालीम पर ख़र्च करना चाहिए।

summary.recap_en: ख़बर is one item of news where समाचार is the whole bulletin. मुल्क and देश match in gender but not in compounds, and neither do तालीम and शिक्षा. Across all fifteen pairs the most reliable difference is not formality at all — it is that the Sanskrit side takes the institutions and the compounds, and the other side keeps the conversation.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the fourth reading block — emails, and the first news item.
